fc_sub: Your flight flies from %s. The fight's area and the enemy are drawn at random; the AWACS gives your task and where by radio.
fc_skill: Enemy skill: %s, as set on the Pilot screen.
fc_no_start: No Scramble start for this jet: run ./modern-iaf-setup.
manuals_sub: PDF files in English. A manual opens in the system's PDF viewer.
desc_startup: Start the engine and bring the avionics up.
desc_range: Radar, gun, missiles and bombs on the range's drones and ground targets.
obj_climb: Climb out with the gear up on the runway heading (±%d°)
obj_air_kills: Shoot down %d of the range's drones
obj_safe: No crash or damage, the wheels on the pavement
lo_seen_below: Seen from below, where the stores hang
need_ground: The mission needs bombs: add a %s
map_flight: THE WHOLE FLIGHT ON THE MAP
no_recording: This sortie has no flight recording.
done_startup: The engine at idle with the avionics up. Nothing failed.
done_takeoff: Airborne with the gear up on the runway heading. Nothing failed.
done_range: The range's drones and ground targets down as asked. Nothing failed.
scenery_missing: Setup's optional step "Buildings, trees and roads" adds them.
scenery_left_out: Left out in setup: tick "Buildings, trees and roads" in setup to add them.
keys_sub: Click a command, then press its new key. Esc cancels.
joystick_sub: Give each axis its role. Click a command, then press its button.
joy_buttons_note: The hat turns the view to its eight directions, as the numpad's look keys do.
loading_slow: A first start after an update prepares the graphics for this computer once: it takes longer.
discard_text: The name, the nickname or the picture changed and was not saved.
reset_text: This deletes every flight and debrief of %s. The name, the nickname and the picture stay.
reset_sure_text: The flights cannot be brought back after the reset.
delete_text: This deletes %s: the name, the nickname, the picture and every flight and debrief.
delete_sure_text: The profile cannot be brought back after the delete.
first_pilot_sub: The name and the nickname show on every screen; your flights go into this pilot's log.
combat_wingmen: Of them, the flight's other jets
no_missions: No training missions: the sim's data is not built yet. To build it, run:
nb_ack: Read and acknowledge: not modelled in the sim
nb_hint_batt: Now at BATT: one more click to MAIN PWR
nb_hint_rpm: Wait: RPM %d %% of 20 %%; the throttle stays at OFF
nb_hint_throttle_off: The throttle to OFF first, then up to idle
nb_hint_ins_off: INS knob: one click to STOR HDG
nb_hint_ins_wait: Aligning: %d s left; the knob stays at STOR HDG until ALIGN flashes
nb_hint_ins_norm: NORM aligns in 8 minutes: %d s left; then the knob to NAV
nb_hint_ins_nav: Aligned (ALIGN flashes): the knob to NAV
nb_hint_selftest: All steps done: the avionics' self test is still running
nb_help: %s stow  ·  %s / %s or wheel: page  ·  click a tab
fl_kept: The pass is kept. Continue the flight, or end it now for the debrief.
fl_radio_awacs_off: No requests: AWACS reports by itself.
frame_measured: Frame time measured on this computer (cockpit view, %s)
frame_measured_none_head: Frame time measured on this computer
frame_none: Not measured yet. Each flight measures it between its 10th and 30th second.
frame_estimate: With the settings now: about %s ms (estimated from the measured costs).
preset_about: Sets all the graphics settings at once. Laptop keeps the flight smooth on a laptop's built-in graphics; Balanced and High add detail; Everything on turns every effect on. Custom shows when you change a setting yourself.
antialiasing_about: Smooths the jagged edges of the cockpit frame, the runway lines and the horizon. MSAA 4× is sharp; + FXAA also smooths thin lines; TAA smooths most and blurs a little; FSR 2 smooths and works with Upscaling.
upscaling_about: Draws the world at a lower size and scales it up to the window. Quality and Balanced draw fewer pixels and save frame time; the cockpit's text stays sharp.
shadows_about: The sun's shadows: the jet's shadow on the runway, the canopy frame's shadow in the cockpit, the buildings' on the streets.
shadow_reach_about: How far from the jet the sun's shadows are drawn. Far draws the towns' shadows up to 2.5 km away, so a town keeps its depth from the air.
terrain_detail_about: How finely the ground's shape is drawn at a distance. Lower values draw fewer hills and ridges far away.
clouds_about: Flat layer draws the mission's clouds as a flat sheet. Volumetric draws them as real clouds you can fly through and around.
scenery_about: Draws the towns, villages and trees from the setup step "Buildings, trees and roads". Off leaves the photo ground alone. Detailed adds every small building near the jet.
fullscreen_about: Fills the whole screen with the game, without the window's frame.
vsync_about: Waits for the screen's refresh before showing a frame: no torn picture when you turn quickly.
language_about: The language of every screen, the radio's subtitles and the notebook. It changes at once.
engine_volume_about: The engine's loudness. Moving the slider plays the engine at the new level.
sfx_volume_about: The loudness of the warnings, switches and weapons. Moving the slider plays the master caution tone.
speech_volume_about: The loudness of the tower, the other pilots and Betty's warnings. Moving the slider plays a tower call.
update_mode_about: On start: a newer version of the game, and setup steps to run again after a change. Ask shows a dialog with Update and Later; Always download runs them without asking; Never checks nothing. Offline, no new version is offered.
flight_controls_about: What flies the jet: the keyboard, or a joystick's stick. Keyboard is the default when no joystick is connected.
rudder_about: What moves the rudder: the keyboard, or rudder pedals (an axis on the Joystick screen).
throttle_about: What sets the engine's power: the keyboard, or a throttle lever (an axis on the Joystick screen).
throttle_detent_about: Where the afterburner starts on your throttle lever. Put the lever at its click, then choose Set at lever. Off makes the lever's travel even, the afterburner at its end.
stick_response_about: Linear moves the jet as much as the stick moves. Soft centre makes small stick moves gentler, for fine aiming.
keys_screen_about: Every command's key, and the keys you can change.
joystick_screen_about: The joystick's axes and buttons: which axis does what, its dead zone, and a command for each button.
pre_hint: Click a row, then a target, a steerpoint or a point on the map. Right-click a row clears it.
pre_footer: Without a pick: the mission's target (%s). In flight %s steps through all of them.
pre_refused: That pick cannot be used: choose a target of this mission.
pre_footer_none: Without a pick a bomb has no target before you step one. In flight %s steps through the targets.
msg:No goggles: use the helmet's night c: No goggles: use the helmet's night camera
